2607.11515.title: Dzongkha Next Word Prediction System
2607.11515.paper_summary: Dzongkha, being the national language of Bhutan, is a common and widely spoken language in the country. Official documents, scriptures and other literature products are written in Dzongkha in order to retain the cultural value. However, documenting Dzongkha writing is a challenging and time-consuming process, largely due to the complexity of the script, the need for multiple keystrokes per syllable, and the limited availability of efficient typing tools. An immediate system that can predict and display a list of probable words for Dzongkha is the solution for this problem. The project is mainly aimed to make Dzongkha typing as convenient as possible by reducing the number of keystrokes. Our dataset is acquired from DCDD and has a total of 100000 sentences, 1331282 words and 28344 unique words. The data preprocessing was done by removing all the alphanumeric characters, tokenization, generating N-gram sequences and padding. Three models selected for training are LSTM, Bi-LSTM and GRU. The training process included fine-tuning of the model's hyperparameters. GRU being lightweight and able to handle larger datasets performed best with 74.03% accuracy and also solved the problem of overfitting.
2607.11515.paper_summary_zh: Dzongkha，作為不丹的國語，是該國一種常見且廣泛使用的語言。<lb/>官方文件、經文和其他文學作品都是用Dzongkha撰寫，以保持其文化價值。<lb/>然而，記錄Dzongkha的書寫是一個具有挑戰性且耗時的過程，主要是由於字母的複雜性、每個音節需要多次按鍵以及高效打字工具的有限可用性。<lb/>一個能夠預測並顯示Dzongkha可能單詞列表的即時系統是解決這個問題的方案。<lb/>該項目的主要目的是通過減少按鍵數量，使Dzongkha的打字變得盡可能方便。<lb/>我們的數據集來自DCDD，共有100000個句子、1331282個單詞和28344個獨特單詞。<lb/>數據預處理的過程包括去除所有字母數字字符、標記化、生成N-gram序列和填充。<lb/>選擇的三個訓練模型是LSTM、Bi-LSTM和GRU。<lb/>訓練過程包括對模型超參數的微調。<lb/>GRU因為輕量且能處理更大的數據集，表現最佳，準確率達到74.03%，並且解決了過擬合問題。
